package.name: aav_ego
package.description: ego's launch file (ego.launch.py), config (ego.yaml) and maths in Python with no ROS (ackermann.py, dynamics.py, vehicle_model.py and the rest: limits, ramps, the lead, the trace). The nodes ego and look_ahead, which turn the muxed /control/cmd_vel Twist into /ego/actuator_cmd Ackermann commands, are aav_ego_rs's (Rust); the Python nodes were removed on 22 Nov 2026.
